## Why This Is Asked
Tests tenant isolation, cross-region cache invalidation, and DR readiness in AWS DB stacks.

- ElastiCache Redis per-tenant keys

## Code Example

```javascript
function purgeTenantCache(redis, tenantId){
  const prefix=`tenant:${tenantId}:`;
  for (let key of redis.scanIterator(prefix+'*')){
    redis.del(key)
  }
}
```

- How would you test the purge in a DR drill?
- What metrics signal a successful purge?
